|errata_history={{Card errata/A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V)}}
This is errata version PC-E1 of [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 1, Original)]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 1, Original)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 1 preview<ref name="eh1351-adt-0">[https://www.scribd.com/document/248870122/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Expansion-Set-1 Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 1 preview, Dark Side Interrupts (public mirror)].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Set 1 preview); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 1, Original) first published}} Text: “If opponent's starting location was Massassi Throne Room, opponent loses 1 Force when you play this Interrupt. Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee Rules Team ruling, effective immediately<ref name="eh1351-adt-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1104241#p1104241 Players Committee Rules Team, 12 March 2017 ruling, effective immediately].</ref>. First published 12 March 2017. The card image with this text and the “E” mark is in the PC Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “If opponent's starting location was Massassi Throne Room, opponent loses 1 Force when you play this Interrupt. Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be canceled (unless being redrawn) or modified.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “or modified”; words removed: “modified or”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-adt-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/adarktimefortherebellion.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022).</ref>. First published 3 October 2022. Text: “If opponent's starting location was Massassi Throne Room, opponent loses 1 Force when you play this Interrupt. Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be canceled (unless being redrawn) or modified.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
